overall_notes: The paper focuses on extractive multi-document summarization using a novel sub-graph selection approach. It uses both automatic (ROUGE) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate with minor improvements needed for dataset/model completeness and normalization. No LLM evaluation was used.
